stem:
Sonia stirs salt into a glass of water until no salt grains can be seen. Alok stirs chalk powder into a second glass of water; the chalk settles on the bottom.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Salt-water is a solution because its components are evenly distributed.
Chalk-water is a solution because both mixtures were stirred.
Chalk-water is not a solution because the chalk is not evenly distributed.
Salt-water is not a solution because salt and water began as separate substances.

teacher.key_rationale: A solution has components evenly distributed. Salt-water does; chalk that settles does not. Stirring alone or starting as separate substances does not decide.
